notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.15
notes.content:
* "Reset Spell Picks" now temporarily added to Character Info Sheet.
* Selecting "Learn Spell" or "Ready Spell" no longer resets the lists.
* Spells can now be removed from the Ready List by using the Right Mouse Button.
* Spells can now be added to the Ready List by using the Right Mouse Button.

notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.14
notes.content:
* Sign Unpower I, II, and III drain strength slightly reduced.
* AI Cleric Call Dead & Raise timings adjusted.
* An Additional XP Boost Check will happen when the match starts.
* Added Total Time Played.
* Added Kill Bounty Top List (Hit TAB while in Game)

notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.13
notes.content:
* Shock IV damage increased.
* Shock V damage increased.
* Prayer no longer affects incoming Mind & Void Spells.
* Increased Airwall opacity to 0.6 (up from 0.25)
* Slow effects now apply a Stamina Regen Penalty
* Fly Effects now apply a Stamina Regen Penalty
* Stealth Effects now apply a Stamina Regen Penalty
* Haste Effects now apply a Stamina Regen Penalty
* Sprinting now applies a Mana Regen Penalty (10%)
* Sign Unpower Redesigned. Now applies Mana Drain DoT with Mana Regen Penalty.
* Mana DoT VFX redesigned. 
* Fixed bug where Shrine Victory would not toggle off.
* AI Clerics "Call Dead" action now has a 15 second cooldown (up from 5 seconds)

notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.12
notes.content:
* Lightning 1-5 should now register hits more frequently. 
* Enemies should no longer Heal Shrines.
* Allies should no longer Destroy their own Shrines
* AI Clerics should no longer get stuck in their own Shrine.
* Level Bracket 1-20 now properly identifies 1-20 characters.
* Dynamic Shrine Material once again properly changes.
* 2T Games now show the correct Shrine Health.
* In Game Spell Changer is now working again.

notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.11
notes.content:
* Fixed Missing Texture in The Cathedral
* Can no longer Crouch while Flying.
* Fixed Bug where player remains a ghost after being raised.
* Added Discord Hyperlink to Game's Newsfeed
* Bug fixed preventing characters to be selected for 1-20 match.

notes.title: Change Notes for v0.0.2.10
